    "'use client';\n\nimport * as React from 'react';\nimport { useIsoLayoutEffect } from '@base-ui/utils/useIsoLayoutEffect';\nimport { useStableCallback } from '@base-ui/utils/useStableCallback';\nimport { useTimeout } from '@base-ui/utils/useTimeout';\nimport { EMPTY_ARRAY } from '@base-ui/utils/empty';\nimport { isElementVisible, isListIndexDisabled } from \"../utils/composite.mjs\";\nimport { contains } from \"../utils/element.mjs\";\nimport { stopEvent } from \"../utils/event.mjs\";\n/**\n * Provides a matching callback that can be used to focus an item as the user\n * types, often used in tandem with `useListNavigation()`.\n * @see https://floating-ui.com/docs/useTypeahead\n */\nexport function useTypeahead(context, props) {\n  const {\n    listRef,\n    elementsRef,\n    activeIndex,\n    onMatch: onMatchProp,\n    disabledIndices,\n    onTyping,\n    enabled = true,\n    resetMs = 750,\n    selectedIndex = null\n  } = props;\n  const store = 'rootStore' in context ? context.rootStore : context;\n  const open = store.useState('open');\n  const timeout = useTimeout();\n  const stringRef = React.useRef('');\n  const prevIndexRef = React.useRef(selectedIndex ?? activeIndex ?? -1);\n  const matchIndexRef = React.useRef(null);\n  const onKeyDown = useStableCallback(event => {\n    function getElement(index) {\n      return elementsRef?.current[index];\n    }\n    function isItemAvailable(index) {\n      const element = getElement(index);\n      if (element && !isElementVisible(element) || element?.matches(':disabled')) {\n        return false;\n      }\n      // Visibility and native disabled state are handled above;     "import { isElement } from '@floating-ui/utils/dom';\nimport { Timeout } from '@base-ui/utils/useTimeout';\nimport { contains, getTarget } from \"./utils/element.mjs\";\nimport { getNodeChildren } One line, since it sits beside other tasks'\n * in `splates list --files`.\n */\nexport function goalLine(text: string): string | null {\n\tconst md = Markdown.parse(text);\n\tif (!md.has(\"Goal\")) {\n\t\treturn null;\n\t}\n\tconst line = md\n\t\t.section(\"Goal\")\n\t\t.body.split(\"\\n\")\n\t\t.find((line) => line.trim() !== \"\");\n\treturn line === undefined ? null : line.trim();\n}\n\n/**\n * What an `SPLATES.md` says done means: all of `## Goal`, as markdown, or \"\"\n * when it says nothing yet.\n */\nexport function goalOf(text: string): string {\n\tconst md = Markdown.parse(text);\n\treturn md.has(\"Goal\") ? md.section(\"Goal\").body.trim() : \"\";\n}\n\n/**\n * One `- [ ] 9.` item under `## Blocked`: something only a person can do.\n * The item's line is its subject; lines indented under it are its body, and\n * `- (a) ...`, `- [a] ...` or `- a. ...` lines among them are the answers it\n * offers.\n */\nexport interface Question {\n\t/** As the plan numbers it, `9`: the name a reply goes by. */\n\tnumber: string;\n\t/** Checked off, which the agent does once it has acted on the reply. */\n\tdone: boolean;\n\t/** The item's own line, without its checkbox, number, size or reply. */\n\ttext: string;\n\t/**\n\t * How far the call reaches, from the `(large)` that leads its line, one of\n\t * `SIZES` as the skill writes it; null when it has none.\n\t */\n\tsize: string | null;\n\t/**\n\t * The markdown indented under it, dedented, choices left out: detail,\n\t * code blocks, `![shot](/abs/path.png)` images. Empty when there is none.\n\t */\n\tbody: string;\n\t/** Whatever follows ` → `, or null when nobody has answered yet. */\n\treply: string | null;\n\t/**\n\t * What a person added once the reply was read, oldest first: each an\n\t * indented `→ ` line under the question.\n\t */\n\tfollowUps: string[];\n\t/**\n\t * The answers it offers, in order. Empty for a question answered in words\n\t * alone. A reply can always add words to its picks, or answer in words\n\t * instead.\n\t */\n\tchoices: Choice[];\n\t/**\n\t * `one` for `- (a)` choices, at most one of which a reply picks; `any` for\n\t * `- [a]` choices, where it picks all that apply; `order` for `- a.`\n\t * choices, which a reply puts in order, every one of them, as `b, a, c`.\n\t * Null without choices.\n\t */\n\tpick: \"one\" | \"any\" | \"order\" | null;\n}\n\n/** One answer a question offers: `- (b) Migrate on next login`. */\nexport interface Choice {\n\t/** The letter it goes by: `b`. */\n\tkey: string;\n\t/** What it says, without the `(chosen)` that may end it. */\n\ttext: string;\n\t/**\n\t * The markdown indented under it, dedented: most often the screenshot of\n\t * what it would look like. Empty when there is none.\n\t */\n\tbody: string;\n\t/**\n\t * Why the agent would go with it, or not: a `Why:` line under it, without\n\t * the label, kept out of `body`. The page folds\n\t * it away until asked. Empty when there is none.\n\t */\n\twhy: string;\n\t/**\n\t * Marked `(chosen)`: what the agent went with while it waits for the reply,\n\t * which picks nothing for the person.\n\t */\n\tchosen: boolean;\n}\n\nconst ITEM = /^[ \\t]*- \\[([ xX])\\] [Qq]?(\\d+)\\.[ \\t]*(.*)$/;\n/** What separates an item from its reply, spaces included. */\nconst ARROW = \" → \";\n/** A follow-up: a line of its own under the question, led by the arrow. */\nconst FOLLOW_UP = /^[ \\t]+→[ \\t]+(.*)$/;\n/** `- (a) text` picks one, `- [a] text` picks any, `- a. text` is put in order. */\nconst CHOICE =\n\t/^([ \\t]+)- (?:\\(([a-z])\\)|\\[([a-z])\\]|([a-z])\\.)[ \\t]+(.+?)[ \\t]*$/;\n/** What ends the choice the agent went with. */\nconst CHOSEN = /[ \\t]*\\(chosen\\)$/i;\n\n/**\n * How far a call reaches, smallest first, as the skill defines each: small\n * stays local and is cheap to redo, medium shapes a feature or spans\n * systems, large is hard to undo or outward-facing. The one place the scheme\n * lives: outcomes keep each call's size as the word it was written with, so\n * a word dropped from here still reads back from older outcomes.\n */\nexport const SIZES = [\"small\", \"medium\", \"large\"] as const;\n/** The `(large)` that leads an item's line: any one lowercase word. */\nconst SIZE = /^\\(([a-z]+)\\)[ \\t]+/;\n\n/** `text` without the size that leads it, and that size, or null. */\nexport function sized(text: string): { text: string; size: string | null } {\n\tconst size = SIZE.exec(text);\n\treturn size === null\n\t\t? { text, size: null }\n\t\t: { text: text.slice(size[0].length), size: size[1] as string };\n}\n\n/**\n * Every numbered item under `## Blocked`, open or checked off, each with the\n * indented lines under it. The reply is read off the item's own line: an\n * answer is one line after the arrow, which the agent writes in from the\n * user's reply in chat.\n */\nexport function questions(text: string): Question[] {\n\treturn items(sectionLines(text, \"Blocked\"));\n}\n\n/**\n * Every numbered item under `## Assumptions`: a call the agent made without\n * asking, written as a question is, its `(chosen)` choice the one it took.\n * Numbered in the same sequence as `## Blocked`, since a challenged one moves\n * there under its number. None of them hold up a merge.\n */\nexport function assumptions(text: string): Question[] {\n\treturn items(sectionLines(text, \"Assumptions\"));\n}\n\n/** The numbered items among `lines`, each with the indented lines under it. */\nfunction items(lines: { line: string }[]): Question[] {\n\tconst found: { asked: Question; body: string[] }[] = [];\n\t// The question the lines being read sit under, if they still do.\n\tlet last: { asked: Question; body: string[] } | undefined;\n\tfor (const { line } of lines) {\n\t\tconst asked = question(line);\n\t\tif (asked !== null) {\n\t\t\tlast = { asked, body: [] };\n\t\t\tfound.push(last);\n\t\t\tcontinue;\n\t\t}\n\t\t// A line back at the margin ends the question; blank ones do not.\n\t\tif (line.trim() !== \"\" && !/^[ \\t]/.test(line)) {\n\t\t\tlast = undefined;\n\t\t}\n\t\tif (last === undefined) {\n\t\t\tcontinue;\n\t\t}\n\t\tconst followUp = FOLLOW_UP.exec(line);\n\t\tif (followUp !== null) {\n\t\t\tlast.asked.followUps.push((followUp[1] ?? \"\").trim());\n\t\t} else if (!offers(last.asked, line)) {\n\t\t\tlast.body.push(line);\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn found.map(({ asked, body }) => settled(asked, body));\n}\n\n/** How far each choice's dash is indented, which what is under it goes past. */\nconst INDENTS = new WeakMap<Choice, number>();\n\n/**\n * Adds what `line` offers to `asked`, saying whether it did: an indented\n * `- (a) text` picks one, `- [a] text` picks any, and `- a. text` is put in\n * order, and a line indented past a choice's dash, such as its screenshot,\n * belongs to that choice. The first choice says which for the question. The\n * same in a plan and in a conversation, which `asked.ts` reads with this.\n */\nexport function offers(\n\tasked: Pick<Question, \"choices\" | \"pick\">,\n\tline: string,\n): boolean {\n\tconst choice = CHOICE.exec(line);\n\tif (choice === null) {\n\t\tconst last = asked.choices.at(-1);\n\t\tconst indent = /^[ \\t]*/.exec(line)?.[0].length ?? 0;\n\t\tif (\n\t\t\tlast === undefined ||\n\t\t\tline.trim() === \"\" ||\n\t\t\tindent <= (INDENTS.get(last) ?? indent)\n\t\t) {\n\t\t\treturn false;\n\t\t}\n\t\tlast.body = last.body === \"\" ? line : `${last.body}\\n${line}`;\n\t\treturn true;\n\t}\n\tconst [, indent = \"\", one, any, order, text = \"\"] = choice;\n\tconst offered: Choice = {\n\t\tkey: one ?? any ?? order ?? \"\",\n\t\ttext: text.replace(CHOSEN, \"\"),\n\t\tbody: \"\",\n\t\twhy: \"\",\n\t\tchosen: CHOSEN.test(text),\n\t};\n\tINDENTS.set(offered, indent.length);\n\tasked.choices.push(offered);\n\tasked.pick ??=\n\t\tone !== undefined ? \"one\" : any !== undefined ? \"any\" : \"order\";\n\treturn true;\n}\n\n/** `asked` with `body` as its own, and each choice's dedented. */\nexport function settled(asked: Question, body: string[]): Question {\n\tasked.body = dedent(body);\n\tfor (const choice of asked.choices) {\n\t\tObject.assign(choice, reasoned(dedent(choice.body.split(\"\\n\"))));\n\t}\n\treturn asked;\n}\n\n/** A choice's rationale, on a line of its own: `Why: no one is signed out`. */\nconst WHY = /^why:[ \\t]*(.*)$/i;\n\n/**\n * A choice's dedented `body` with its first `Why:` line taken out as `why`,\n * so a screenshot before or after it stays the body.\n */\nfunction reasoned(body: string): Pick<Choice, \"body\" | \"why\"> {\n\tconst lines = body.split(\"\\n\");\n\tconst at = lines.findIndex((line) => WHY.test(line));\n\tif (at === -1) {\n\t\treturn { body, why: \"\" };\n\t}\n\treturn {\n\t\tbody: dedent(lines.filter((_, index) => index !== at)),\n\t\twhy: (WHY.exec(lines[at] ?? \"\")?.[1] ?? \"\").trim(),\n\t};\n}\n\n/** Lines with the indent they all share taken off, blank ends trimmed. */\nexport function dedent(lines: string[]): string {\n\tconst indents = lines\n\t\t.filter((line) => line.trim() !== \"\")\n\t\t.map((line) => /^[ \\t]*/.exec(line)?.[0].length ?? 0);\n\tconst cut = indents.length === 0 ? 0 : Math.min(...indents);\n\treturn lines\n\t\t.map((line) => line.slice(cut).trimEnd())\n\t\t.join(\"\\n\")\n\t\t.replace(/^\\n+|\\s+$/g, \"\");\n}\n\n/**\n * How the person met the agent's picks under `## Blocked`: the questions\n * asked, those that offered a `(chosen)` choice and were answered with a\n * choice, and of those, the ones answered with another, and the ones answered\n * with the agent's choice but with words added, in the reply or a follow-up.\n * A moot question, or one answered in words alone, is asked but picks nothing.\n */\nexport function picks(text: string): {\n\tasked: number;\n\tpicked: number;\n\toverturned: number;\n\tamended: number;\n} {\n\tconst asked = questions(text);\n\tconst met = asked.map(metPick).filter((each) => each !== null);\n\treturn {\n\t\tasked: asked.length,\n\t\tpicked: met.length,\n\t\toverturned: met.filter((each) => each === \"overturned\").length,\n\t\tamended: met.filter((each) => each === \"amended\").length,\n\t};\n}\n\n/**\n * How the person met the agent's pick on `asked`: null when it offered none,\n * picks any or an order, or was answered in words alone or not at all.\n */\nfunction metPick(asked: Question): \"kept\" | \"amended\" | \"overturned\" | null {\n\tconst chosen = asked.choices.find((choice) => choice.chosen);\n\t// `(b) ...`, `- (b) ...`, or a lone `b` or `b.`, as replies are written\n\t// back; never the `a` that starts \"a lot\".\n\tconst reply = asked.reply ?? \"\";\n\tconst [lead, wrapped, bare] =\n\t\t/^(?:- )?(?:\\(([a-z])\\)|([a-z])(?=[.,]|$))/i.exec(reply) ?? [];\n\tconst key = wrapped ?? bare;\n\tif (chosen === undefined || key === undefined || asked.pick !== \"one\") {\n\t\treturn null;\n\t}\n\tif (key.toLowerCase() !== chosen.key) {\n\t\treturn \"overturned\";\n\t}\n\treturn /[a-z0-9]/i.test(reply.slice(lead?.length ?? 0)) ||\n\t\tasked.followUps.length > 0\n\t\t? \"amended\"\n\t\t: \"kept\";\n}\n\n/**\n * One call a plan made, as an outcome keeps it: enough to count how the\n * agent's recommendations fare by size, and to size it again by its line if\n * the scheme changes.\n */\nexport interface Decision {\n\t/** As the plan numbers it. */\n\tnumber: string;\n\t/** The item's line, without its size. */\n\ttext: string;\n\t/** The word its line was sized with, or null for none. */\n\tsize: string | null;\n\t/** Put to the person under `## Blocked`, or made without asking. */\n\thow: \"asked\" | \"assumed\";\n\t/**\n\t * What became of the agent's recommendation: an assumption left alone is\n\t * kept; a pick taken as it was, kept; taken with words added, amended;\n\t * answered with another choice, overturned; an assumption the person\n\t * challenged, challenged. Null for a question with no pick to meet, or\n\t * one never answered with a choice.\n\t */\n\tended: \"kept\" | \"amended\" | \"overturned\" | \"challenged\" | null;\n}\n\n/** Every call in the plan `text`, asked and assumed, in the order numbered. */\nexport function decisions(text: string): Decision[] {\n\tconst each = (\n\t\titem: Question,\n\t\thow: Decision[\"how\"],\n\t\tended: Decision[\"ended\"],\n\t): Decision => ({\n\t\tnumber: item.number,\n\t\ttext: item.text,\n\t\tsize: item.size,\n\t\thow,\n\t\tended,\n\t});\n\treturn [\n\t\t...assumptions(text).map((item) => each(item, \"assumed\", \"kept\")),\n\t\t...questions(text).map((item) =>\n\t\t\tCHALLENGED.test(item.reply ?? \"\")\n\t\t\t\t? each(item, \"assumed\", \"challenged\")\n\t\t\t\t: each(item, \"asked\", metPick(item)),\n\t\t),\n\t].sort((one, other) => Number(one.number) - Number(other.number));\n}\n\n/** The reply that moves an assumption to `## Blocked`. */\nconst CHALLENGED = /^challenged\\b/i;\n\n/**\n * How many calls the agent made without asking, and how many of them the\n * person challenged. A challenged one moves to `## Blocked` under its number\n * with a reply starting `challenged:`, so it counts in both.\n */\nexport function assumptionCounts(text: string): {\n\tmade: number;\n\tchallenged: number;\n} {\n\tconst challenged = questions(text).filter((each) =>\n\t\tCHALLENGED.test(each.reply ?? \"\"),\n\t).length;\n\treturn { made: assumptions(text).length + challenged, challenged };\n}\n\n/** What still stands between a task and trunk, as its plan tells it. */\nexport interface Unfinished {\n\t/** Each unchecked question under `## Blocked`, by number: `[\"2\", \"4\"]`. */\n\tquestions: string[];\n\t/** Each unchecked step under `## Next`, as written. */\n\tsteps: string[];\n}\n\nconst STEP = /^[ \\t]*- \\[ \\][ \\t]*(.*)$/;\n\n/**\n * The questions and steps a plan leaves unchecked. Nothing in either means the\n * task is ready to merge: `splates merge` lands it, and `splates escalate --review`\n * asks a person to look first. A task with no plan has nothing left.\n */\nexport function unfinished(text: string): Unfinished {\n\tconst md = Markdown.parse(text);\n\tconst next = md.has(\"Next\") ? md.section(\"Next\").body.split(\"\\n\") : [];\n\treturn {\n\t\tquestions: questions(text)\n\t\t\t.filter((asked) => !asked.done)\n\t\t\t.map((asked) => asked.number),\n\t\tsteps: next.flatMap((line) => {\n\t\t\tconst step = STEP.exec(line)?.[1];\n\t\t\treturn step === undefined ? [] : [step.trim()];\n\t\t}),\n\t};\n}\n\n/** Whether {@link unfinished} found nothing left. */\nexport function ready({ questions, steps }: Unfinished): boolean {\n\treturn questions.length === 0 && steps.length === 0;\n}\n\n/** What {@link unfinished} found, as a clause: `questions 1, 2 unchecked under ## Blocked`. */\nexport function whatIsLeft({ questions, steps }: Unfinished): string {\n\treturn [\n\t\tquestions.length > 0\n\t\t\t? `questions ${questions.join(\", \")} unchecked under ## Blocked`\n\t\t\t: \"\",\n\t\tsteps.length > 0\n\t\t\t? `${steps.length} step${steps.length === 1 ? \"\" : \"s\"} unchecked under ## Next`\n\t\t\t: \"\",\n\t]\n\t\t.filter(Boolean)\n\t\t.join(\" and \");\n}\n\n/**\n * The plan with a new open question at the end of `## Blocked`, the section\n * made if missing, numbered after the highest there or under\n * `## Assumptions`. Returns the plan and the number it went by.\n */\nexport function withQuestion(\n\ttext: string,\n\tsubject: string,\n\tbody = \"\",\n): { plan: string; number: string } {\n\tconst numbers = [...questions(text), ...assumptions(text)].map((asked) =>\n\t\tNumber(asked.number),\n\t);\n\tconst number = String(Math.max(0, ...numbers) + 1);\n\tconst detail = body.trim() === \"\" ? [] : body.trim().split(\"\\n\");\n\tconst item = [\n\t\t`- [ ] ${number}. ${subject.trim()}`,\n\t\t...detail.map((line) => `  ${line}`.trimEnd()),\n\t];\n\tconst blocked = sectionLines(text, \"Blocked\");\n\tif (blocked.length === 0 && !/^## Blocked[ \\t]*$/im.test(text)) {\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tplan: `${text.trimEnd()}\\n\\n## Blocked\\n\\n${item.join(\"\\n\")}\\n`,\n\t\t\tnumber,\n\t\t};\n\t}\n\tconst lines = text.split(\"\\n\");\n\tconst last = blocked.findLast(({ line }) => line.trim() !== \"\");\n\tconst heading = lines.findIndex((line) => /^## Blocked[ \\t]*$/i.test(line));\n\tconst at = last === undefined ? heading + 1 : last.index + 1;\n\tlines.splice(at, 0, ...(last === undefined ? [\"\", ...item] : item));\n\treturn { plan: lines.join(\"\\n\"), number };\n}\n\n/**\n * A question's number however a person typed it: `9`, `9.`, `Q9` and `q9:`\n * all mean `9`. Null for anything that is not a number at all.\n */\nexport function questionNumber(raw: string): string | null {\n\tconst digits = /^q?(\\d+)[.:]?$/i.exec(raw.trim())?.[1];\n\treturn digits === undefined ? null : String(Number(digits));\n}\n\nfunction question(line: string): Question | null {\n\tconst item = ITEM.exec(line);\n\tif (item === null) {\n\t\treturn null;\n\t}\n\tconst [, check = \" \", number = \"\", rest = \"\"] = item;\n\tconst arrow = rest.indexOf(ARROW);\n\tconst { text, size } = sized(\n\t\t(arrow === -1 ? rest : rest.slice(0, arrow)).trim(),\n\t);\n\treturn {\n\t\tnumber,\n\t\tdone: check !== \" \",\n\t\ttext,\n\t\tsize,\n\t\tbody: \"\",\n\t\treply: arrow === -1 ? null : rest.slice(arrow + ARROW.length).trim(),\n\t\tfollowUps: [],\n\t\tchoices: [],\n\t\tpick: null,\n\t};\n}\n\n/**\n * The lines under the section headed `name`, with where each sits in the\n * whole file so a reply can be written back in place.\n */\nfunction sectionLines(\n\ttext: string,\n\tname: string,\n): { index: number; line: string }[] {\n\tconst { sections } = Markdown.parse(text);\n\tconst at = sections.findIndex(\n\t\t(section) => section.heading.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase(),\n\t);\n\tconst blocked = sections[at];\n\tif (blocked === undefined) {\n\t\treturn [];\n\t}\n\tconst lines = text.split(\"\\n\");\n\t// `line` is 1-based, so it is also the index of the line after the heading.\n\tconst end =\n\t\tsections.slice(at + 1).find((later) => later.level <= blocked.level)\n\t\t\t?.line ?? Advisory only: a resumable\n * plan is the point, and a malformed one still beats none, so nothing here\n * blocks a merge.\n */\nexport function checkPlan(\n\ttext: string,\n\t{ task, escalated = false, review = false }: PlanOptions,\n): string[] {\n\tconst md = Markdown.parse(text);\n\tconst problems: string[] = [];\n\tconst section = (name: string) =>\n\t\tmd.has(name) ? md.section(name).body : null;\n\n\tif (md.title !== task) {\n\t\tproblems.push(\n\t\t\tmd.title === null\n\t\t\t\t? `no title: the first line should be \"# ${task}\"`\n\t\t\t\t: `title is \"# ${md.title}\", should be \"# ${task}\"`,\n\t\t);\n\t}\n\tfor (const name of REQUIRED) {\n\t\tif (!md.has(name)) {\n\t\t\tproblems.push(`no ## ${name} section`);\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif (section(\"Goal\") === \"\") {\n\t\tproblems.push(\"## Goal is empty: say in a line or two what done means\");\n\t}\n\tconst done = section(\"Done\");\n\tif (done !== null && UNCHECKED.test(done)) {\n\t\tproblems.push(\"## Done has a `- [ ]` item: it belongs under ## Next\");\n\t}\n\tconst blocked = section(\"Blocked\");\n\t// A review asks only to approve merging, which needs no question.\n\tif (escalated && !review && blocked === null) {\n\t\tproblems.push(\n\t\t\t\"escalated with no ## Blocked section: add `- [ ] 1.` items for what the reviewer must do\",\n\t\t);\n\t}\n\tif (blocked !== null && !QUESTION.test(blocked)) {\n\t\tproblems.push(\n\t\t\t\"## Blocked lists nothing: add `- [ ] 1.` items for what the reviewer must do\",\n\t\t);\n\t}\n\t// Answered and unchecked is a follow-up to act on;     "//#region src/runtime/utils/tool-call-tree.ts\n/**\n* Walk every tool-call part reachable from `messages`. A tool call projects a\n* child run as nested messages on `ToolCallMessagePart.messages`, so a\n* subagent's own calls live below the top-level content and a seam that only\n* scans the top level cannot reach them.\n*\n* Parts arrive in document order, each one ahead of its own descendants.\n* `messageId` names the message that directly holds the part, which for a\n* nested call is the child run's message rather than the top-level message the\n* tree hangs from.     "import { isMcpAppUri } from \"../../types/message.js\";\n//#region src/react/utils/groupParts.ts\n/**\n* Hierarchical adjacent-coalescing grouping for message parts.\n*\n* Given a group path per part (from `groupBy`), builds a tree of group\n* nodes wrapping individual parts.     "/**\n * Like `Array#splice`, but smarter for giant arrays.\n *\n * `Array#splice` takes all items to be inserted as individual argument which\n * causes a stack overflow in V8 when trying to insert 100k items for instance.\n *\n * Otherwise, this does not return the removed items, and takes `items` as an\n * array instead of rest parameters.\n *\n * @template {unknown} T\n *   Item type.\n * @param {Array<T>} list\n *   List to operate on.\n * @param {number} start\n *   Index to remove/insert at (can be negative).\n * @param {number} remove\n *   Number of items to remove.\n * @param {Array<T>} items\n *   Items to inject into `list`.\n * @returns {undefined}\n *   Nothing.\n */\nexport function splice(list, start, remove, items) {\n  const end = list.length;\n  let chunkStart = 0;\n  /** @type {Array<unknown>} */\n  let parameters;\n\n  // Make start between zero and `end` (included).\n  if (start < 0) {\n    start = -start > end ?     "/**\n * Some of the internal operations of micromark do lots of editing\n * operations on very large arrays. This runs into problems with two\n * properties of most circa-2020 JavaScript interpreters:\n *\n *  - Array-length modifications at the high end of an array (push/pop) are\n *    expected to be common and are implemented in (amortized) time\n *    proportional to the number of elements added or removed, whereas\n *    other operations (shift/unshift and splice) are much less efficient.\n *  - Function arguments are passed on the stack, so adding tens of thousands\n *    of elements to an array with `arr.push(...newElements)` will frequently\n *    cause stack overflows. (see <https://stackoverflow.com/questions/22123769/rangeerror-maximum-call-stack-size-exceeded-why>)\n *\n * SpliceBuffers are an implementation of gap buffers, which are a\n * generalization of the \"queue made of two stacks\" idea. The splice buffer\n * maintains a cursor, and moving the cursor has cost proportional to the\n * distance the cursor moves, but inserting, deleting, or splicing in\n * new information at the cursor is as efficient as the push/pop operation.\n * This allows for an efficient sequence of splices (or pushes, pops, shifts,\n * or unshifts) as long such edits happen at the same part of the array or\n * generally sweep through the array from the beginning to the end.\n *\n * The interface for splice buffers also supports large numbers of inputs by\n * passing a single array argument rather passing multiple arguments on the\n * function call stack.\n *\n * @template T\n *   Item type.\n */\nexport class SpliceBuffer {\n  /**\n   * @param {ReadonlyArray<T> | null | undefined} [initial]\n   *   Initial items (optional).\n   * @returns\n   *   Splice buffer.\n   */\n  constructor(initial) {\n    /** @type {Array<T>} */\n    this.left = initial ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : end;\n    if (stop < this.left.length) {\n      return this.left.slice(start, stop);\n    }\n    if (start > this.left.length) {\n      return this.right.slice(this.right.length - A task it added is splates's own line instead.\n */\nexport const StartUI = makeAssistantDataUI<{ start: LanesStart }>({\n\tname: \"start\",\n\trender: ({ data }) => <StartCard start={data.start} />,\n});\n\nexport function StartCard({ start }: { start: LanesStart }): JSX.Element {\n\t// Its lanes show beside the thread once it scrolls up out of sight.\n\treturn (\n\t\t<div ref={useStartCard(start)}>\n\t\t\t<CardShell\n\t\t\t\tlabel={`started ${start.lanes.join(\", \")}`}\n\t\t\t\ttitle=\"Started\"\n\t\t\t\tlanes={start.lanes}\n\t\t\t\tIcon={SproutIcon}\n\t\t\t>\n\t\t\t\t{start.goal === \"\" ? undefined : <CardBody text={start.goal} />}\n\t\t\t</CardShell>\n\t\t</div>\n\t);\n}\n\nexport function ReportCard({\n\treport,\n\ttiming,\n}: {\n\treport: Report;\n\ttiming?: ReportTiming;\n}): JSX.Element {\n\tconst { Icon, tone } = ENDINGS[report.ending];\n\t// A Working card whose time has stopped, once later words replace it,\n\t// says the work is past.\n\tconst title =\n\t\treport.ending === \"working\" && timing?.until != null\n\t\t\t? \"Worked\"\n\t\t\t: ENDINGS[report.ending].title;\n\t// A lane orchestrator's Working card says what changed; the plan, live,\n\t// takes the place of its lines on each lane in the latest one only, the\n\t// others folded to what changed, since only the latest is current. Its\n\t// latest Finished card keeps its lines, on what came of each todo, and\n\t// shows how many landed, and when, under them.\n\tconst planned = report.ending === \"working\" && \"lanes\" in report;\n\tconst latest = useLatestOnLanes(report);\n\tconst finished = report.ending === \"finished\" && latest;\n\tconst text = planned\n\t\t? reportText({ ...report, body: leadOf(report.body) })\n\t\t: reportText(report);\n\t// Shows the markdown the agent wrote in place of the card's body, until\n\t// toggled back; never kept, so the card opens rendered.\n\tconst [showing, setShowing] = useState(false);\n\t// One that merged or removed its task ends it beside the thread too.\n\tconst ended = useEndCard(report);\n\tconst archivable = useArchivable(report);\n\treturn (\n\t\t<div ref={ended}>\n\t\t\t<CardShell\n\t\t\t\tlabel={`${report.ending} ${\"lanes\" in report ? report.lanes.join(\", \") : report.task}`}\n\t\t\t\tIcon={Icon}\n\t\t\t\ttitle={title}\n\t\t\t\ttone={tone}\n\t\t\t\t{...(\"lanes\" in report\n\t\t\t\t\t? { lanes: report.lanes }\n\t\t\t\t\t: { task: report.task, base: report.base, to: report.to })}\n\t\t\t\taside={\n\t\t\t\t\t<ReportAside\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttiming={report.ending === \"working\" ? timing : undefined}\n\t\t\t\t\t\tshowing={showing}\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttoggle={() => setShowing(!showing)}\n\t\t\t\t\t/>\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t>\n\t\t\t\t{showing ? (\n\t\t\t\t\t<>\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<Source text={report.source} />\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<CardArchive report={report} />\n\t\t\t\t\t</>\n\t\t\t\t) : planned ? (\n\t\t\t\t\t<>\n\t\t\t\t\t\t{text !== \"\" && (\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<CardBody text={text} lead={report.reason !== null} />\n\t\t\t\t\t\t)}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t{latest && <PlanBoard />}\n\t\t\t\t\t</>\n\t\t\t\t) : text === \"\" && report.ending !== \"merged\" && !finished ? (\n\t\t\t\t\tarchivable ? (\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<CardArchive report={report} />\n\t\t\t\t\t) : undefined\n\t\t\t\t) : (\n\t\t\t\t\t<>\n\t\t\t\t\t\t{text !== \"\" && (\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<Folded>\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<CardBody text={text} lead={report.reason !== null} />\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t</Folded>\n\t\t\t\t\t\t)}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t{report.ending === \"merged\" && \"task\" in report && (\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<MergedStats task={report.task} />\n\t\t\t\t\t\t)}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t{finished && <PlanBoard reported />}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<CardArchive report={report} />\n\t\t\t\t\t</>\n\t\t\t\t)}\n\t\t\t</CardShell>\n\t\t</div>\n\t);\n}\n\n/**\n * Whether `report` is the last report on lanes in its thread: no later one in\n * its message, nor in any message after it.\n */\nfunction useLatestOnLanes(report: Report): boolean {\n\treturn useAuiState((state) => {\n\t\tif (!(\"lanes\" in report)) {\n\t\t\treturn false;\n\t\t}\n\t\tconst { messages } = state.thread;\n\t\tconst own = messages[state.message.index];\n\t\treturn (\n\t\t\town !== undefined &&\n\t\t\tonLanes(own).at(-1)?.source === report.source &&\n\t\t\tmessages\n\t\t\t\t.slice(state.message.index + 1)\n\t\t\t\t.every((each) => onLanes(each).length === 0)\n\t\t);\n\t});\n}\n\n/** The reports on lanes in `message`, in order. */\nfunction onLanes(message: ThreadMessage): Report[] {\n\treturn message.content.flatMap((part) =>\n\t\tpart.type === \"data\" &&\n\t\tpart.name === \"report\" &&\n\t\t\"lanes\" in (part.data as { report: Report }).report\n\t\t\t? [(part.data as { report: Report }).report]\n\t\t\t: [],\n\t);\n}\n\n/** What a report on lanes says before its lines on each lane. */\nfunction leadOf(body: string): string {\n\tconst lines = body.split(\"\\n\");\n\tconst at = lines.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith(\"- \"));\n\treturn (at === -1 ? lines : lines.slice(0, at)).join(\"\\n\").trim();\n}\n\n/**\n * `children` cut to a few lines in a narrow thread, as on a phone, with More\n * to read the rest; in full anywhere wider, or once it fits.\n */\nfunction Folded({ children }: { children: ReactNode }): JSX.Element {\n\tconst [open, setOpen] = useState(false);\n\tconst box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n\tconst [cut, setCut] = useState(false);\n\tuseEffect(() => {\n\t\tconst element = box.current;\n\t\tif (element === null || open) {\n\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t}\n\t\tconst measure = () =>\n\t\t\tsetCut(element.scrollHeight > element.clientHeight + 1);\n\t\tmeasure();\n\t\tconst observer = new ResizeObserver(measure);\n\t\tobserver.observe(element);\n\t\treturn () => observer.disconnect();\n\t}, [open]);\n\treturn (\n\t\t<div className=\"relative\">\n\t\t\t<div\n\t\t\t\tref={box}\n\t\t\t\tclassName={cn(\n\t\t\t\t\t!open &&\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\"@max-md:max-h-32 @max-md:overflow-hidden @max-md:[mask-image:linear-gradient(to_bottom,black_60%,transparent)]\",\n\t\t\t\t)}\n\t\t\t>\n\t\t\t\t{children}\n\t\t\t</div>\n\t\t\t{cut && !open && (\n\t\t\t\t<button\n\t\t\t\t\ttype=\"button\"\n\t\t\t\t\tonClick={() => setOpen(true)}\n\t\t\t\t\tclassName=\"flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-center gap-1 border-t font-medium text-muted-foreground text-sm active:bg-muted @md:hidden\"\n\t\t\t\t>\n\t\t\t\t\tMore\n\t\t\t\t\t<ChevronDownIcon className=\"size-4\" />\n\t\t\t\t</button>\n\t\t\t)}\n\t\t</div>\n\t);\n}\n\n/** A report's markdown as the agent wrote it, to read or copy. */\nfunction Source({ text }: { text: string }): JSX.Element {\n\tconst { copied, copy } = useCopy();\n\treturn (\n\t\t<div className=\"relative\">\n\t\t\t<pre className=\"max-h-96 overflow-auto whitespace-pre-wrap break-words px-4 py-3.5 pr-24 font-mono text-[12px] leading-relaxed\">\n\t\t\t\t{text}\n\t\t\t</pre>\n\t\t\t<Button\n\t\t\t\tsize=\"sm\"\n\t\t\t\tvariant=\"outline\"\n\t\t\t\ttitle={copied.state === \"failed\" ? copied.error : undefined}\n\t\t\t\tonClick={() => copy(text)}\n\t\t\t\tclassName=\"absolute top-2.5 right-2.5 h-7 pointer-coarse:h-10 gap-1.5 bg-background\"\n\t\t\t>\n\t\t\t\t{copied.state === \"copied\" ? (\n\t\t\t\t\t<CheckIcon data-icon=\"inline-start\" />\n\t\t\t\t) : (\n\t\t\t\t\t<CopyIcon data-icon=\"inline-start\" />\n\t\t\t\t)}\n\t\t\t\t<span aria-live=\"polite\">{copiedLabel(copied, \"Copy\")}</span>\n\t\t\t</Button>\n\t\t</div>\n\t);\n}\n\n/**\n * Starts todo `id` in a new conversation, with `assignee` when given; none\n * outside a conversation.\n */\nexport const StartNewContext = createContext<\n\t((id: number, assignee: AgentPick | null) => void) | null\n>(null);\n\n/**\n * The reply a todo is written in: the task it ran in, when the prompt it\n * answers was sent, and when it last moved; each null where the log cannot say.\n */\nexport interface Turn {\n\ttask: string | null;\n\tbegan: string | null;\n\tuntil: string | null;\n}\n\n/**\n * Renders a `data-todo` part, a run of todos proposed one after another, as\n * the cards for them. Those the reply's own task added while it ran are\n * gathered by the lane they went to, Untriaged for none, under a line saying\n * so, for as long as the board has them; the rest stand alone, under \"Next\n * up\" when `next` says the run follows a task's end.\n */\nexport const TodoUI = makeAssistantDataUI<{\n\ttodos: TodoProposal[];\n\tturn?: Turn;\n\tnext?: boolean;\n}>({\n\tname: \"todo\",\n\trender: ({ data }) => (\n\t\t<InMessage>\n\t\t\t<TodoRun\n\t\t\t\tproposals={data.todos}\n\t\t\t\tturn={data.turn ?? null}\n\t\t\t\tnext={data.next ?? false}\n\t\t\t/>\n\t\t</InMessage>\n\t),\n});\n\n/** Whether `todo` came up in `turn`'s task while it ran. */\nfunction addedIn(todo: TodoState, turn: Turn | null): boolean {\n\tif (\n\t\tturn === null ||\n\t\tturn.task === null ||\n\t\ttodo.from !== turn.task ||\n\t\tturn.began === null ||\n\t\tturn.until === null\n\t) {\n\t\treturn false;\n\t}\n\tconst at = Date.parse(todo.createdAt);\n\treturn Date.parse(turn.began) <= at && at <= Date.parse(turn.until);\n}\n\n/**\n * `proposals` in order, each next to another added to the same lane joined\n * to it: `lane` is undefined for one not added, null for one added to none.\n */\nfunction gathered(\n\tproposals: TodoProposal[],\n\ttodos: TodoState[],\n\tturn: Turn | null,\n): { lane: number | null | undefined; proposals: TodoProposal[] }[] {\n\tconst groups: {\n\t\tlane: number | null | undefined;\n\t\tproposals: TodoProposal[];\n\t}[] = [];\n\tfor (const proposal of proposals) {\n\t\tconst live = todos.find((each) => each.id === proposal.id);\n\t\tconst lane =\n\t\t\tlive !== undefined && addedIn(live, turn) ? live.lane : undefined;\n\t\tconst last = groups.at(-1);\n\t\tif (last !== undefined && lane !== undefined && last.lane === lane) {\n\t\t\tlast.proposals.push(proposal);\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tgroups.push({ lane, proposals: [proposal] });\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn groups;\n}\n\nfunction TodoRun({\n\tproposals,\n\tturn,\n\tnext,\n}: {\n\tproposals: TodoProposal[];\n\tturn: Turn | null;\n\tnext: boolean;\n}): JSX.Element {\n\tconst board = useContext(Board);\n\tconst groups = gathered(proposals, board.todos, turn);\n\tconst first = groups.find(({ lane }) => lane === undefined);\n\treturn (\n\t\t<>\n\t\t\t{groups.map((group) => {\n\t\t\t\tconst { lane, proposals } = group;\n\t\t\t\treturn lane === undefined ? (\n\t\t\t\t\tnext && group === first ? (\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<div key={proposals[0]?.id} className=\"mt-6 mb-3\">\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<p className=\"mb-1 flex items-center gap-1.5 pl-1 text-muted-foreground text-xs\">\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<ArrowRightIcon aria-hidden className=\"size-3.5 text-primary\" />\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<span className=\"font-medium text-foreground\">Next up</span>\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t</p>\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\">\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t{proposals.map((proposal) => (\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<TodoCard key={proposal.id} proposal={proposal} grouped />\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t))}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t</div>\n\t\t\t\t\t\t</div>\n\t\t\t\t\t) : (\n\t\t\t\t\t\tproposals.map((proposal) => (\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<TodoCard key={proposal.id} proposal={proposal} />\n\t\t\t\t\t\t))\n\t\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t\t) : (\n\t\t\t\t\t<div key={proposals[0]?.id} className=\"my-3 @max-md:my-4\">\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<p className=\"mb-1 flex items-center gap-1.5 pl-1 text-muted-foreground text-xs\">\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<ListPlusIcon aria-hidden className=\"size-3.5 text-primary\" />\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<span>\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<span className=\"font-medium text-foreground\">\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tAdded {proposals.length > 1 && `${proposals.length} `}to{\" \"}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t{board.lanes.find((each) => each.id === lane)?.name ??\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"Untriaged\"}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t</span>{\" \"}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tby this task\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t</span>\n\t\t\t\t\t\t</p>\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<div\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tclassName={cn(\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"flex flex-col gap-2\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t// A rail ties two or more cards to the line; one needs none.\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tproposals.length > 1 &&\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"ml-[11px] border-primary/30 border-l-2 pl-3\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t)}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t>\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t{proposals.map((proposal) => (\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<TodoCard key={proposal.id} proposal={proposal} grouped />\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t))}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t</div>\n\t\t\t\t\t</div>\n\t\t\t\t);\n\t\t\t})}\n\t\t</>\n\t);\n}\n\nexport function TodoCard({\n\tproposal,\n\tgrouped = false,\n}: {\n\tproposal: TodoProposal;\n\t/** Whether it stands in a group, which spaces it. */\n\tgrouped?: boolean;\n}): JSX.Element {\n\tconst board = useContext(Board);\n\tconst { reply, sent } = useCardReply();\n\tconst reference = todoReference(proposal.id);\n\tconst settled = sent !== null;\n\tconst started = sent?.includes(reference) ?? false;\n\tconst live = board.todos.find((each) => each.id === proposal.id) ?? null;\n\tconst todo = settled ? null : live;\n\tconst gone = !settled && board.linked && todo === null;\n\tconst lane =\n\t\ttodo?.lane == null\n\t\t\t? null\n\t\t\t: (board.lanes.find((each) => each.id === todo.lane) ?? null);\n\tconst send = reply?.send ?? null;\n\tconst { refusal, attempt } = useRefusal();\n\tconst startNew = useContext(StartNewContext);\n\tconst open = todo !== null && todo.takenBy === null;\n\treturn (\n\t\t<section\n\t\t\taria-label={`todo ${proposal.id}`}\n\t\t\tclassName={cn(\n\t\t\t\t\"flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border border-border/60 bg-card py-2.5 pr-2.5 pl-3 text-card-foreground transition-colors hover:border-border\",\n\t\t\t\t// On a phone, as far from the words as any card.\n\t\t\t\t!grouped && \"my-3 @max-md:my-4\",\n\t\t\t\tgone && \"opacity-60\",\n\t\t\t)}\n\t\t>\n\t\t\t{/* On a phone the words take the icon's width, so they wrap less. */}\n\t\t\t<ListTodoIcon\n\t\t\t\taria-hidden\n\t\t\t\tclassName=\"mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground @max-md:hidden\"\n\t\t\t/>\n\t\t\t<div className=\"flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1\">\n\t\t\t\t{live === null ? not.\n\t\t\t\t\t<button\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttype=\"button\"\n\t\t\t\t\t\tonClick={() => board.open(proposal.id)}\n\t\t\t\t\t\tclassName=\"cursor-pointer self-start rounded text-left font-medium text-sm outline-none hover:underline focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring\"\n\t\t\t\t\t>\n\t\t\t\t\t\t{todo?.subject ?? proposal.subject}\n\t\t\t\t\t</button>\n\t\t\t\t)}\n\t\t\t\t{proposal.body !== \"\" && (\n\t\t\t\t\t<Markdown\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttext={proposal.body}\n\t\t\t\t\t\tclassName=\"text-muted-foreground text-xs leading-relaxed [&_p:first-child]:mt-0 [&_p:last-child]:mb-0\"\n\t\t\t\t\t/>\n\t\t\t\t)}\n\t\t\t\t{/* Its buttons end the line that numbers it, rather than take a\n\t\t\t\t    row of their own. */}\n\t\t\t\t<div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2\">\n\t\t\t\t\t<span className=\"flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 text-muted-foreground text-xs\">\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<span className=\"tabular-nums\">#{proposal.id}</span>\n\t\t\t\t\t\t{lane !== null && (\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t<span title=\"lane\"     "import type { Tally } from \"@stringsync/splates/stats\";\n\n/** Which card an `Advice` is, for the page to rank it and give it its chart. */\nexport type AdviceId =\n\t| \"course\"\n\t| \"picks\"\n\t| \"assumptions\"\n\t| \"waiting\"\n\t| \"hotspot\"\n\t| \"failures\"\n\t| \"removals\";\n\n/** One figure worth acting on, and what to do about it. */\nexport interface Advice {\n\tid: AdviceId;\n\ttitle: string;\n\t/** Shown large: `12%`; Found only in the body, the detail\n * becomes a snippet around the first word there.\n */\nfunction scoreOf(\n\twords: string[],\n\ttitle: string,\n\tbody: string,\n): { score: number; detail?: string } | null {\n\tif (words.length === 0) {\n\t\treturn { score: WHOLE };\n\t}\n\tconst lower = title.toLowerCase();\n\tconst phrase = words.join(\" \");\n\tif (lower === phrase) {\n\t\treturn { score: WHOLE };\n\t}\n\tlet score = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n\tlet snippet: string | undefined;\n\tfor (const word of words) {\n\t\tconst scored = inTitle(lower, word);\n\t\tif (scored !== null) {\n\t\t\tscore = Math.min(score, scored);\n\t\t\tcontinue;\n\t\t}\n\t\tconst at = body.toLowerCase().indexOf(word);\n\t\tif (at === -1) {\n\t\t\treturn null;\n\t\t}\n\t\tscore = Math.min(score, BODY);\n\t\tsnippet ??= snippetOf(body, at, word.length);\n\t}\n\treturn snippet === undefined ? { score } : { score, detail: snippet };\n}\n\nfunction inTitle(title: string, word: string): number | null {\n\tif (title.startsWith(word)) {\n\t\treturn START;\n\t}\n\tif (new RegExp(`(^|[^\\\\p{L}\\\\p{N}])${escaped(word)}`, \"u\").test(title)) {\n\t\treturn WORD;\n\t}\n\treturn title.includes(word) ?
